sections.title: Advanced Fiction Workshop: Short Fiction
sections.description: This workshop is suitable for students with some prior experience in fiction who are interested in pushing their practice further. Students will write and workshop their own original stories as well as discuss works of fiction. To learn more about this course, visit the Creative Writing Program at https://creative.writing.upenn.edu.

sections.title: Advanced Fiction Workshop: Short Fiction
sections.description: The class will be conducted as a seminar. Every student will write four stories during the semester; each story will be discussed by the group. The instructor will, from time to time, suggest works of fiction that he hopes will be illustrative and inspirational but there will be no required books. Attendance and active class participation are essential.
